name: Connecticut
author: PSWBSF
description:
Map of the state of Connecticut, USA. Made using depot and US Demand Generator by slurry, with map tiles generated using the Map Patcher by Kronifer. BIG thanks to slurry for generating the demand data and other files necessary for the creation of this map. Without his help, this would not have been possible.

If you would like me to add a special demand point, or notice a mistake, please ping @pswbsf on the Subway Builder or Railyard discord.

Uses 2023 LODES data and includes additional demand data as follows:

Airports

  • Bradley International Airport (BDL)

  • Tweed New Haven Airport (HVN)

Universities

  • All Connecticut State Community Colleges

  • University of Connecticut

  • Yale University

  • Sacred Heart University

  • Central Connecticut State University

  • Quinnipiac University

  • University of Hartford

  • Other colleges are included, but not as special demand points

Entertainment/Tourism

  • Connecticut Science Center

  • Yale Peabody Museum

  • Yale University Art Gallery

  • Mystic Museum

Stadiums

  • Pratt & Whitney Stadium

  • PeoplesBank Arena

  • Yale University Athletic Fields

Shopping

  • Westfarms

  • Danbury Fair

  • Connecticut Post Mall

  • Trumbull Mall

  • Note: Since the number of visitors for malls are not recorded anywhere, each of these locations have 4000 commuters

Ferries

  • Cross Sound Ferry

Military Bases

  • Naval Submarine Base New London
